# Example Co

> Example Co makes invoicing software for freelancers and small agencies. Plans start at $12/month.

Example Co sends invoices, tracks payments and reminds clients automatically. It works in 30 currencies and connects to Stripe and PayPal.

## Product

- [How it works](https://example.com/how-it-works): setup in three steps, from first invoice to payment
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing): three plans, monthly or annual billing
- [Integrations](https://example.com/integrations): Stripe, PayPal, Xero, QuickBooks

## Guides

- [How to write an invoice](https://example.com/guides/write-an-invoice): what to include, with a free template
- [Late payment reminders](https://example.com/guides/late-payments): wording and timing that work

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://example.com/changelog): product updates
- [About](https://example.com/about): team and contact
